title: Stolk et al. 2018 FieldTrip iEEG protocol dataset (SubjectUCI29): authors' preprocessed ECoG+SEEG epochs
description: Preprocessed intracranial EEG (ECoG and SEEG) from one epilepsy patient (SubjectUCI29) released with the FieldTrip human intracranial analysis protocol of Stolk et al. (2018). The data comprise 26 epochs of 152 channels sampled at 5000 Hz, aligned to target-tone onset in an auditory detection task with a button-press response. The epochs were demeaned, low-pass filtered and band-stop filtered by the original authors. The raw recordings were not shared, so the dataset is packaged as a BIDS derivative together with electrode coordinates.
methods_description: Recordings were made with a Nihon Kohden JE-120A amplifier at 5 kHz in a patient with medication-refractory epilepsy implanted with ECoG grids (64 and 32 contacts) and seven 8-contact SEEG depth leads. Trials were defined from the tone-onset trigger (-0.4 to 0.9 s). Preprocessing used FieldTrip ft_preprocessing: demeaning, 200 Hz low-pass filter, and band-stop filters at 59-61, 119-121 and 179-181 Hz.
